outdir=pathlib.Path('/workspace/fuzzfind'); outdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

interesting=[]
ops=['flip','set','del','ins','splice','truncate','arith']
start=time.time()
for i in range(20000):
    data=bytearray(random.choice(seeds))
    # sometimes focus first 500 bytes
    for _ in range(random.randint(1,8)):
        op=random.choice(ops)
        if op=='flip' and data:
            p=random.randrange(len(data)); data[p]^=1<<random.randrange(8)
        elif op=='set' and data:
            p=random.randrange(len(data)); data[p]=random.choice([0,1,2,3,4,5,8,9,10,13,31,65,127,128,192,224,240,248,255])
        elif op=='del' and data:
            p=random.randrange(len(data)); n=random.randint(1,min(20,len(data)-p)); del data[p:p+n]
        elif op=='ins':
            p=random.randrange(len(data)+1); n=random.randint(1,10); data[p:p]=os.urandom(n)
        elif op=='splice' and data:
            other=random.choice(seeds); p=random.randrange(len(data)+1); q=random.randrange(len(other)); n=random.randint(1,min(50,len(other)-q)); data[p:p]=other[q:q+n]
        elif op=='truncate' and data:
            if random.random()<0.3: data=data[:random.randrange(len(data)+1)]
        elif op=='arith' and data:
            p=random.randrange(len(data)); data[p]=(data[p]+random.choice([-2,-1,1,2,16,127]))&255
    path=outdir/f'id_{i}'
    path.write_bytes(data)
    try:
        r=subprocess.run([bin,str(path)], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=2)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        print('timeout', i, len(data)); continue
    err=r.stderr+r.stdout
    if r.returncode!=0 and (b'ERROR: AddressSanitizer' in err or b'heap-buffer-overflow' in err):
        crash=outdir/f'crash_{i}'
        shutil.copy(path, crash)
        print('CRASH', crash, 'len', len(data), 'rc', r.returncode)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        print(err.decode('latin1','replace')[:4000])
        break
    if i%1000==0:
        print('iter',i,'time',time.time()-start)
        sys.stdout.flush()
else:
    print('no crash')
